provenance.notes: Verified on the official author guidelines: 8 pages including figures and tables, extra pages only for cited references, double-blind. The author kit (github.com/cvpr-org/author-kit) has cvpr.sty and main.tex. The review option, columns, font and paper size are NOT stated on the pages checked: the front matter below follows the kit's usual structure and is unverified. Prefer to copy your text into the kit's own main.tex.

limits.text: 8 pages including figures and tables. Additional pages only for cited references.

anonymity.text: No identifying acknowledgements or supplementary material; no links to sites that identify the authors.

facts.text: Eight pages including figures and tables; extra pages only for references.
Double-blind; non-anonymous papers are rejected without review.
Author kit with cvpr.sty and main.tex.
`[review]` option, two columns, US Letter, 10 pt.
